title: Agent Swarm Orchestrator - Base Implementation
description: Create the core swarm coordinator class that manages multi-agent task execution with Opus orchestrator and Sonnet workers
context: Team in a Box has 28 agents defined in employeeData.ts. We need orchestration layer to coordinate them in swarms. Opus 4.6 = orchestrators, Sonnet 4.5 = workers.
requirements: Build task queue system (SwarmTask interface with parallel/sequential/conditional types)
Worker pool management (assign tasks to available agents)
Basic orchestration logic: task assignment, progress monitoring, result aggregation
Model routing: Opus for orchestrators, Sonnet for workers
acceptance_criteria: SwarmOrchestrator class exists and is well-documented
Can create a swarm with 1 orchestrator + N workers
Can assign tasks to workers and track completion
Messages flow between orchestrator and workers
Model routing logic correctly assigns Opus vs Sonnet

interfaces_needed: SwarmMessage { from, to, type, payload, timestamp, threadId }
SwarmTask { id, type, orchestrator, workers, goal, subtasks, status, results }
SubTask { id, assignedTo, description, status, result }

validation: Create simple test: 1 orchestrator + 2 workers completing a basic task (e.g., 'summarize this text'). Verify messages flow and results aggregate.
